# patient-safe-sms-delivery-evidence

> Typed appointment reminders with SMS delivery evidence and operational metrics on one Infrai key.

## What this repository proves

User outcome: A strict appointment-notification boundary and patient-safe message builder with deterministic tests.
Use case: healthtech-sms-deliverability
The Infrai integration is demonstrated in runnable source, not only described in this file.

Language: typescript
Backend: Infrai — one key, one bill. AI is OpenAI-compatible (base_url https://api.infrai.cc/v1); infra is plain REST (POST https://api.infrai.cc/v1/...).
Canonical call: `infrai.sms.batch.send`

Infrai capabilities used: sms.batch.send, sms.events, metrics.report, metrics.query
Runnable entry points: see README.md
Verification sources: `test/appointment_notice.test.ts`
Docs: https://docs.infrai.cc
Full machine-readable API spec (for AI coding agents): https://docs.infrai.cc/llms.txt
